Hi Anna — thanks for the clear questions. Short answer up front: we treat promotional trial credits as non-taxable marketing grants at time of issuance; taxable events occur when the customer consumes paid usage that is invoiced (or when a paid top-up is purchased). That said, to apply reverse-charge on EU consumption invoices we do need a validated EU VAT ID for your entity.

A few details and next steps:

- Trial credits: recorded as promotional allowances in our billing system (not invoiced). No VAT charged on issuance because there's no consideration being paid.
- Consumption invoices: when you redeem credits, the invoice line reflects usage consumed. If BrightWare is VAT-registered in an EU member state and we can validate the VAT ID via VIES, we will zero-rate VAT on the invoice and mark it as reverse-charge (customer responsible for VAT).
- Prepaid paid top-ups: treated as supply of digital services. Place-of-supply is where the customer belongs (B2B rules). If you are VAT-registered and validated, these will also be reverse-charged.

Could you send your VAT registration number? If you prefer, upload the VAT certificate to the Drive link below. Once we validate, I will route to Finance (cc Marissa and Ben) to mark the next invoice series for reverse-charge and include the VRN on invoices.
